title: Re-point lore-check.yml LORE_SOURCE_REF to lore-cli dev squash of #702 (0.15.0 pair cut follow-up)
description: Follow-up in the quest/lore pair release cut for ODOC-556, re-scoped OPENLY from the 0.14.2 plan to 0.15.0 (opum-doc ruling OA-r354-pair-0142-semver, option A, recorded as dec-0kfl7kc A with the operator's own ready-mark of quest-cli#709 and lore-cli#702). It was filed as "after lore-cli#702 lands, re-point LORE_SOURCE_REF" for the 0.14.2 cut, when #706 pinned dff81a039ea5d4df7705ef1040802d14e3385b30 (head of lore-cli#702, branch chore/LCLI-775-bump-0.14.2, package.json 0.14.2). The pair then moved to 0.15.0: #709 pinned af4bc9d8c1b6fc4eba9204da95c3bd96a1306199 (lore-cli#702's new head, package.json 0.15.0), and this task re-points that to eb13ece3ffa6ed2c3ad17362476e7045eecfafa1, lore-cli's dev squash of #702. The reason is unchanged: the source fallback does a plain git clone of lore-cli then cat-file -e on that ref (lines ~214-219); a plain clone fetches branches and tags only, so once #702's branch is auto-deleted a PR-branch head stops resolving and every quest-cli PR lore check goes red until lore 0.15.0 reaches npm latest. A dev squash resolves. Same one-line field and same precedent as the 0.14.1 bump (#629).

acceptanceCriteria.text: LORE_SOURCE_REF in .github/workflows/lore-check.yml names lore-cli's dev squash commit of #702 (eb13ece3ffa6ed2c3ad17362476e7045eecfafa1, replacing af4bc9d8, a PR-branch head), verified by ref to carry package.json 0.15.0 and to resolve after the #702 branch is deleted
lore check reports success on the PR carrying it, and scripts/lore-pin-staleness.mjs still reads the pin
No other line of the workflow changes

implementationNotes: Re-pointed LORE_SOURCE_REF from af4bc9d8 (a lore-cli#702 PR-branch head) to eb13ece3ffa6ed2c3ad17362476e7045eecfafa1, lore-cli dev squash of #702, verified by ref before editing: package.json @opum-ai/lore 0.15.0 and it is the tip of lore-cli dev. A plain clone stops resolving a deleted PR-branch head, so this removes that failure mode. One line changed in .github/workflows/lore-check.yml; no test or comment named the old SHA (git grep).

RE-SCOPE, 2026-11-01: the title, description and AC 1 described the 0.14.2 plan (dff81a03, chore/LCLI-775-bump-0.14.2, package.json 0.14.2). They now say 0.15.0 and af4bc9d8 -> eb13ece3, per opum-doc OA-r354-pair-0142-semver and dec-0kfl7kc A; AC 1 was amended in place (full-list replace), AC 2 and 3 unchanged. Reviewer finding, low and deliberately not fixed here: lore-check.yml lines 66-72 header ("With 0.13.0 published the npm pin is again the only path") contradicts the env comment that says the source fallback is still in use. Leave it for the follow-up that drops LORE_SOURCE_REF once lore 0.15.0 is on npm latest; that follow-up task does not exist yet and is not filed by this write.

Measured 2026-11-01 for the record, after #702 merged and its branch chore/LCLI-775-bump-0.14.2 was deleted (API 404): in a fresh `git clone --filter=blob:none --no-checkout` of lore-cli, the workflow clone shape, `cat-file -e` resolves BOTH eb13ece3 (reachable from origin/dev) and af4bc9d8 (reachable from no ref: `git for-each-ref --contains` is empty). So the premise this task was filed on, that a deleted PR-branch head stops resolving in that clone, is NOT reproduced: the partial clone appears to fetch the object by SHA from GitHub, which keeps unreferenced commits for some time. The re-point is still correct hardening, because eb13ece3 is reachable from dev and cannot be garbage-collected the way an unreferenced commit eventually can, but it was not shown to fix a live failure.
finalSummary: LORE_SOURCE_REF in .github/workflows/lore-check.yml now names eb13ece3ffa6ed2c3ad17362476e7045eecfafa1, lore-cli dev squash of #702 (package.json 0.15.0, tip of lore-cli dev, verified by ref), replacing af4bc9d8, a PR-branch head. One workflow line plus this record; landed as #712 (squash 8c5e2a6d99026df76426630f0fb1c57a765296d1) after an Opus APPROVE at 05b02087 and green source-gates, Tracker integrity and lore check, the lore check run taking the source path against eb13ece3. Verified: lore built at eb13ece3 reports agents --check up-to-date; lore-pin-staleness reads the pin; a fresh workflow-shaped clone resolves eb13ece3. Caveat recorded in the notes: a fresh clone also still resolves af4bc9d8 after its branch was deleted, so the failure this was filed to prevent was not reproduced; the change is durable-ref hardening, not a demonstrated fix. Scope was re-scoped from the 0.14.2 plan to 0.15.0 openly (OA-r354-pair-0142-semver, dec-0kfl7kc A). Not done, deliberately: the lore-check.yml:66-72 header comment that contradicts the env comment, for the follow-up that drops LORE_SOURCE_REF once lore 0.15.0 is on npm latest.
